content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Fonts online

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy promise simplicity but deliver dependency. They host your files, process payments, and own your customer data. If they shut down or suspend your account, you lose everything. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, by contrast, uses tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform can suspend your business because no platform controls it. This architecture is permanent—built to outlast payment processors that exclude entire countries.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 out of 195 countries. PayPal suspends accounts in restricted regions for up to 180 days with no appeal. These platforms aren't just unavailable—they're actively hostile to creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and similar markets. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and on-chain crypto payments, you eliminate the need for any centralized payment processor. The infrastructure doesn't care where you're located because it's not built on their terms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Platforms like Gumroad charge 10% per sale. PayPal holds funds for months. Sovereign stacks using NOWPayments charge 0.5% for crypto transactions—verified on-chain within minutes. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost? Time. Deploying your own stack requires technical setup, but once live, it operates without platform fees or fund holds. You trade initial complexity for permanent ownership and lower ongoing costs.
Stripe operates in 46 out of 195 countries. Sovereign infrastructure operates in all of them.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With platforms, you rent access. With sovereign infrastructure, you own the tools. Cloudflare Workers automate order processing. Supabase stores orders securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files instantly post-payment. No platform can disable your automation because the logic runs on your infrastructure. This isn't a workaround—it's a structural shift. You own the hosting, the backend, the storage, and the delivery. The customer pays, the file delivers, and no third party touches your revenue.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you need a quick start and can tolerate platform risk, use Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy—but know they can fail you. If you want permanent infrastructure, deploy a sovereign stack. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) sets up Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments in 48 hours. It's not the cheapest option upfront, but it's the only one that guarantees you own the outcome. Choose based on whether you're renting convenience or building sovereignty.
